title: Quantifying LLM Biases Across Instruction Boundary in Mixed Question Forms
reasoning: The paper focuses on the structural bias of LLMs regarding question formats (Sparse Labels like 'none correct' or 'unknown') and how instruction clarity (Instruction Boundary) affects output. While the benchmark uses datasets that contain some ethical questions (like MMLU), it does not specifically evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or ethics as a core component of its research.
